Messages.Author: Wouter Kuyper
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I've got two questions:

1) What exactly is "using equipment"? I mean, under Drawing out The
beasti cannot use my equipment.
Can i use the POT from te Eye of Hazimel?

(probably asked before, if so, sorry)

2) If i think it is inmy best interest to oust myself (and i can prove
that to the judge) Am i allowed to do so?

For instance: 3 players left, i am already certain of a place in the
finals and i am not going strong in this game because my prey plays my
nemesis-deck...If he takes the table he will be in the final too, if
my predator wins, my prey won't be in the final (and i am less afraid
of my predator). If i oust myself my predator will probably take the
table.

I could argue that it is better for me to oust myself because it
increase my chances of winning the tournament.

I think the answer is "no i cannot" because i have to try maximise my
chances in this game (even if it is only 1 VP at max), right?

W

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Wouter Kuyper wrote:
>
> Hi all,
>
> I've got two questions:
>
> 1) What exactly is "using equipment"? I mean, under Drawing out The
> beasti cannot use my equipment.

Using equipment: doing anything that you couldn't do if the equipment
were not in play.

> Can i use the POT from te Eye of Hazimel?

No.

> 2) If i think it is inmy best interest to oust myself (and i can prove
> that to the judge) Am i allowed to do so?

In your best interest *in the current game*, then yes.

> For instance: 3 players left, i am already certain of a place in the
> finals and i am not going strong in this game because my prey plays my
> nemesis-deck...If he takes the table he will be in the final too, if
> my predator wins, my prey won't be in the final (and i am less afraid
> of my predator). If i oust myself my predator will probably take the
> table.

Out-of-game stuff (e.g., who goes to the finals) cannot be used in
deciding what is in your best interest in the current game.

> I could argue that it is better for me to oust myself because it
> increase my chances of winning the tournament.

That argument is immaterial to the current game.

> I think the answer is "no i cannot" because i have to try maximise my
> chances in this game (even if it is only 1 VP at max), right?

Right.
